crafting_base_groups.source_section: 0 피해 변환 사슬 / 4.1·4.2 PoB ③④ 방패 / 8.3
crafting_base_groups.rationale: Crown of Eyes turns spell damage into attack damage, so the shield slot carries a spell-damage prefix; the transition snapshot uses an Ancient Spirit Shield (75% spell damage) and the end of Part 1 a Walnut Spirit Shield with +57 Strength.
The creator alteration-spammed Leviathan Gauntlets, converted the DEX roll to STR with Allflame crafting and finished with bench + exalt; Goliath Gauntlets were the transition pair.

Both end-of-Part-1 rings are crafted Amethyst Rings (+58/+53 Strength, chaos resistance, -7 mana cost bench craft) made from essences via the Harvest bench and Allflame DEX-to-STR conversion; the transition Two-Stone Ring carried +29 Strength.
